summary: Verified new payment-gate security behavior. Created /app/backend/tests/test_payment_gate.py (7 tests, all PASS). Confirmed: (1) Subscription services email/automation/linkbio -> register returns 200 with access_token, /me returns payment_required=true, /login returns HTTP 402 with pt-BR message; /billing/checkout returns a real Stripe checkout_url; after calling SubscriptionService.subscribe() the organizations.payment_pending flag flips to false and /login returns 200 with payment_required=false. (2) Usage services payments/marketplace -> immediate 200 login, payment_required=false. (3) Admin (suportwibaza@hotmail.com) unaffected — logs in with role=admin, payment_required=false (admin is on 'payments' usage service). (4) CORS on /api/auth/register works from same-origin (no wildcard ACAO when returned).
action_items: None — backend payment gate works as specified. Main agent can proceed with frontend integration (ensure login page displays 402 detail message and routes user to /billing/checkout, and that /me payment_required=true triggers a redirect to the pricing/checkout screen).
critical_code_review_comments: auth/routes.py::login does an extra DB read on organizations to check payment_pending — acceptable, but consider caching or embedding payment_pending in the JWT to avoid one query per login at scale.
auth/routes.py::me also does a second DB read for the org just to return payment_required. Fine for now, but could be merged with get_current_user via a joined loader.

subscriptions/service.subscribe() unconditionally sets payment_pending=False even for usage services if called with those services. Not a bug in current flow (only subscription services call it via checkout) but worth guarding: `if service in {'email','automation','linkbio'}` before the update.
auth/service._bootstrap_organization hardcodes the subscription-service set. Consider deriving from pricing DEFAULT_PRICING where model=='subscription' to keep single source of truth.
Login 402 exposes only a pt-BR detail; consider structured JSON (e.g., {code: 'payment_pending', service, checkout_hint_url}) so frontend can localize and deep-link to checkout.
test_credentials: Admin suportwibaza@hotmail.com / LeamseAdmin2026! — verified. Ephemeral test_<uuid>@example.com users created per test.
seed_data_creation: 5 subscription-service test users (email/automation/linkbio x parametrize) + 2 usage-service users + 1 CORS test user per run; no cleanup implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment gate confirmed working. To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_payment_gate.py -v. To flip payment_pending for a user: `from app.modules.subscriptions.service import SubscriptionService; await SubscriptionService().subscribe(org_id, service, 'monthly', 'BRL')`. Frontend still needs verification: (a) Register step 3 should no longer show coupon input or 'Pagar depois' link, (b) After cancel on Stripe, user should be routed back to checkout not dashboard — /me payment_required=true is the flag frontend must respect, (c) Login page must handle 402 by redirecting to /billing/checkout.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug reproduced. Backend implementation matches spec: payment_pending default True for email/automation/linkbio via _bootstrap_organization; login route blocks with 402; subscribe() clears the flag.
